verdict.rationale: Bulk indexing is supported only indirectly. A community tuning tip discusses disabling or raising the refresh interval to speed up bulk indexing. Serverless docs say extra resources are allocated during ingest spikes. Nothing in the pack documents async task tracking for knowing when indexing completes. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a bulk API and its throughput at the scale of millions of documents, async task/status tracking for indexing jobs, and hands-on corroboration of bulk import performance.
